newsitem.title: USA: Meris Labs settles fraud case - U.S. Justice.
newsitem.headline: Meris Labs settles fraud case - U.S. Justice.

text.p: Meris Laboratories Inc will pay $5.2 million to settle claims it filed false claims for reimbursement of laboratory tests under Medicare and Medicaid, the U.S. Justice Department said Wednesday.

It said the agreement settles allegations Meris defrauded Medicare and the California Medicaid programs by improperly billing various laboratory tests, including cholesterol, serum iron and "additional indices" in complete blood count tests.
The alleged fraud began in 1992 and continued until this year, Justice Department officials said.
